turns:
Implement a `Timer` context manager class for measuring elapsed time.
Requirements:
1. Class named exactly Timer.
2. Implement __enter__ and __exit__ (do not use contextlib.contextmanager).
3. Measure with time.perf_counter (monotonic, not time.time).
4. Expose an attribute `elapsed` (float seconds) after the block exits.
5. Re-entering the same instance while it is already running must raise RuntimeError.
6. No I/O inside __enter__/__exit__ (no printing; leave reporting to the caller).
